<function name="GetPassenger" parent="Vehicle" type="classfunc">
	<description>Gets the passenger of the vehicle, returns <page>NULL</page> if no drivers is present.
</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="passenger" type="number">The index of the passenger ( 0 is the driver )</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Entity">The passenger</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
